summary: acer aspire 7 gaming The Acer Aspire Black Nitro Edition v17 with RTX 2070 eGPU is experiencing technical issues, including low benchmark scores, stuttering on external displays, and frequent BSODs. The system's power supply limitations may be contributing to these problems.
detected_fault: Power supply limitations and potential issues with Optimus and driver automation system for dual-GPU configurations
suggested_solution: Update NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 reference BIOS to the latest version, disable internal Intel GPU and iGPU when gaming, use a USB hub or minimize USB connections, update Thunderbolt drivers to the latest version, and consider using a different TB Controller NVM Version.
